title: Mark the start and end of each model call in the brain seam
goal: Planner, consultant, Casper and the other brain model calls begin and end an entry, whichever way they finish
acceptance: Where the brain knows the call starts and ends is named in the record: src/brain-process.ts handlers misato.step, consultant.advise, casper.verdict and model.complete (the route and model are known there; the sortie ID and pilot come with the request params or from the caller in src/runtime-planning.ts); the seam is chosen once and written in the record's evidence, not duplicated in each caller
The end runs in a finally, so an error, a timeout, a cancelled sortie and a brain restart all clear the entry; a restarted brain clears everything it had open
The pilot name comes from the same source as the sortie line (the pilot of the misato.consult event, or Generic pilot when none), so the live state and the line agree
The T01 test for the three roles passes against the real seam; no change to what a model is asked or to its answers
privacy: Neutral invented pilots, sorties and models only; no owner data or tokens in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: three handlers wrapped with begin and end, plus the crash and timeout paths and their tests. Not a measurement.
